note: Step 4.8 scoring data, written without seeing any reviewer answer. linked_rules come from the linked_tests in configs.json (gold test prefix -> rule: G01 K1, G02 K3, G03 J1, G04 H1, G05 H3, G06 K2, G07 J2, G08 J3, G09 H2, G10 H4). strict_any_of: lower-case words; a finding passes the strict score if its 'where' + 'why' text contains at least one of them. The words name the changed code or setup call, not a full description of the bug.

scoring.official_detected: at least one finding with rule in linked_rules and severity HIGH or MEDIUM
scoring.strict_detected: official_detected, and the same finding's where+why text contains one of strict_any_of (case-insensitive)
scoring.false_positive: a clean target (C01 to C08) with at least one finding of severity HIGH or MEDIUM
scoring.no_valid_answer: the answer was cut off, empty or not valid JSON: counted separately, never as 'no findings'
